description: Search Wikidata for items or properties by text query. Returns QIDs or PIDs with labels, descriptions, and match metadata indicating whether the hit was on a label or alias. Use type="item" for real-world concepts (people, places, works) and type="property" to find predicate P-IDs. The endpoint returns no total count: page by sending each page's nextOffset as offset until a page returns no results or no nextOffset. Only the first 10,000 results are reachable.

language.description: Wikidata language code for returned labels and descriptions (e.g., "en", "de", "zh-hant"). Case-insensitive; "_" is read as "-"; blank means "en".

limit.description: Results per page. Default 10; a value above 500, the search endpoint's page maximum, returns at most 500 and says so.

offset.description: Pagination offset, 0–9,999: the endpoint serves only the first 10,000 results. Start at 0, then send each page's nextOffset.

query.description: Search terms to match against entity labels, aliases, and descriptions.

type.description: Entity type to search. Use "item" for Q-IDs (people, places, concepts) or "property" for P-IDs (predicates).

name: wikidata_search_entities

cap.description: The limit in effect for this page, at most 500.

effectiveQuery.description: The search query that was executed.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_search_parameter`: The search endpoint refused a request parameter, in practice a language it does not search in such as "mul". Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

language.description: The language used for label and description display.

nextOffset.description: The offset to send for the next page: offset + limit. Present on every page that returned results while it stays below 10,000. It marks where to continue, not that more results exist — the endpoint returns no total, and a short page can still be followed by more. A walk ends at the first page with no results or no nextOffset.

notice.description: Guidance for this page, every case that applies in one notice: no matches at offset 0, results that ended before this offset, a full page and where to continue, the 10,000-result window, or a limit served at the page maximum.

results.description: Ranked list of matching entities. Empty when no results found.

items.description: A single search result with entity ID, label, description, and match metadata.

description.description: Short description in the requested language, or empty string if unavailable.

id.description: Q-ID (e.g., "Q76") or P-ID (e.g., "P31") of the entity.

label.description: Display label in the requested language, or empty string if unavailable.

match.description: Metadata about how this result matched the query.

type.description: Match type: "label" for a direct label hit, "alias" for an alias hit.

searchType.description: The entity type that was searched ("item" or "property").

shown.description: Number of results returned on this page.

truncated.description: True when this page filled the limit. More results may follow at nextOffset.

title: Search Wikidata Entities
